access.login_failure.name: Cannot log in or access account
access.login_failure.summary: Customers report the app rejects their password or will not let them into their existing account.

billing.premium_only_controls.name: Basic playback controls moved behind Premium
billing.premium_only_controls.summary: Free users say the update removed skipping, choosing, replaying and previous-song controls, forced shuffle, and limited skips, pushing them toward Premium.

catalog.lyrics_availability.name: Lyrics missing or inconsistently shown
catalog.lyrics_availability.summary: Customers report lyrics appear for some songs but not others, or fail to display at times.

catalog.missing_content.name: Many songs and genres unavailable
catalog.missing_content.summary: Customers say many songs are absent from the catalog and certain genres, such as gospel, are thin.

catalog.recommendations_quality.name: Recommendations and shuffle feel random or intrusive
catalog.recommendations_quality.summary: Customers complain that playlist playback is random and that the app pushes unwanted recommendations.

downloads.download_process.name: Song downloads get stuck in background
downloads.download_process.summary: Customers report that downloads remain stuck while running in the background.

downloads.offline_playback_failure.name: Downloaded music fails to play offline
downloads.offline_playback_failure.summary: Customers report that offline playback does not work and downloaded content cannot be played without internet access.

other.boycott_political.name: Boycott calls over political or religious content
other.boycott_political.summary: Some users say they will uninstall or boycott the app because of its country of origin or perceived political and religious stance.

other.generic_criticism.name: Generic negative sentiment without specific defect
other.generic_criticism.summary: Reviewers call the app bad, worst, disappointing, or trash without naming any specific feature or defect.

other.update_regression_generic.name: Recent update disliked without specifics
other.update_regression_generic.summary: Users say a recent update made the app disappointing or useless but do not identify which feature broke.

playback.connectivity_errors.name: Wi-Fi connection failures while online
playback.connectivity_errors.summary: A customer reports being unable to connect to the internet over Wi-Fi when using the app.

playback.crash_or_wont_open.name: App crashes or stuck on loading screen
playback.crash_or_wont_open.summary: Users report the app freezes on the loading or logo screen, or crashes after an update so it cannot be opened.

playback.device_integration.name: Google Assistant plays playlist without songs
playback.device_integration.summary: Customers report that Google Assistant announces playing a Spotify playlist but no songs actually play.

playback.other.name: Music adjustment feature not working properly
playback.other.summary: A customer reports that the music adjustment feature does not work correctly.

playback.playback_interrupted.name: Playback stops halfway and loses position
playback.playback_interrupted.summary: Customers report that music keeps stopping partway through, and on resuming it jumps to a new song instead of continuing where it left off.

usability.ads_frequency_volume.name: Excessive, frequent, and loud ads
usability.ads_frequency_volume.summary: Customers complain that ads appear too often, sometimes after every one or two songs, and are too loud, making the free experience frustrating.

usability.controls_settings.name: Cannot rewind a few seconds after update
usability.controls_settings.summary: A customer reports that after an update they can no longer go back a few seconds in a track, and threatens to delete the app.

usability.playlist_queue_management.name: Limited skipping through unwanted playlist songs
usability.playlist_queue_management.summary: A customer wants to play a single song but must go through an entire playlist, where skipping is limited to six tracks.

usability.ui_redesign_navigation.name: Disliked home screen and UI redesign
usability.ui_redesign_navigation.summary: Customers say recent app updates introduced a home screen and layout redesign they find worse, including unwanted autoplay and difficulty playing or repeating specific song parts.
